definitions.explanation: A microorganism — such as a virus, bacterium, or parasite — that causes disease. A general scientific and medical term covering all types of infectious agents.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{病原体|びょうげんたい}が{発見|はっけん}された。
この{病原体|びょうげんたい}は{空気|くうき}{感染|かんせん}する。
examples.english: This pathogen is transmitted through the air.

examples.japanese: {手洗|てあら}いやマスクは、{病原体|びょうげんたい}の{感染|かんせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐための{基本的|きほんてき}な{対策|たいさく}だ。
examples.english: Handwashing and masks are basic measures to prevent the spread of pathogens.

notes:
Composed of {病原|びょうげん} (cause of disease) + {体|たい} (body, entity). A formal scientific term that became much more widely known through news coverage of infectious disease outbreaks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病原体|びょうげんたい}を{特定|とくてい}する — to identify a pathogen
- {病原体|びょうげんたい}の{感染|かんせん} — infection by a pathogen
- {未知|みち}の{病原体|びょうげんたい} — an unknown pathogen
- {病原体|びょうげんたい}を{排除|はいじょ}する — to eliminate a pathogen

RELATED WORDS:
- ウイルス — virus
- {細菌|さいきん} — bacteria
- {寄生虫|きせいちゅう} — parasite
- {感染症|かんせんしょう} — infectious disease
- {免疫|めんえき} — immunity
